Splitting the fraction into separate terms and then simplifying the fractions in individual terms, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2x-3y+8z}{6} & = \\ \frac{2x}{6}-\frac{3y}{6}+\frac{8z}{6} & = \\ \frac{2}{6}\cdot x-\frac{3}{6}\cdot y+\frac{8}{6}\cdot z & = \\ \frac{1}{3}\cdot x-\frac{1}{2}\cdot y+\frac{4}{3}\cdot z & = \\ \frac{x}{3}-\frac{y}{2}+\frac{4z}{3} & .\end{aligned}
$$
